{{Top|leg}}
A '''DNA Tracer/Tracing Module''' was equipment installed on [[Criminal Location Detection Droid]]s. They allowed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to home-in on [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] traces while tracking a target.
